raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What

Two cuts to the setup that every AMD CI job runs in `amd_ci_install_dependency.sh` before its first test:

| Change | Per job | Expected per week |
|---|---|---|
| Cache the AOT kernel (`sglang-kernel`) wheel on the runner's persistent `/sgl-data` volume | ~30 s build → wheel install on a cache hit | ~350 runner-h (~830 GPU-h) |
| Stop deleting every `.pyc` under `/opt/venv` | ~6 s | ~70 runner-h |

"Per week" assumes the ~41,900 AMD GPU jobs measured in the week of Oct 19–26 and a high hit rate. The real hit rate depends on how often `kernels/aot` and the CI image change. It will be measured after merge.

## Why

The install step takes ~2.3 of the ~2.5 min of per-job setup:
- 30 s of it compiles `python/sglang/kernels/aot` from source with `setup_rocm.py install`, in every job, although that tree rarely changes.
- Another ~6 s is `find /opt/venv -name "*.pyc" -delete` and the `__pycache__` cleanup. The `pip uninstall` calls just before it already remove the old sglang files, so the walk only throws away torch's bytecode, which every job then recompiles on first import.

## Notes for the reviewer

- **Cache key:** the git tree hash of `python/sglang/kernels/aot`, the container's image ID, and the image's GPU arch. Those are the only inputs to the build: `setup_rocm.py` reads nothing outside that directory, and the image fixes torch, HIP and Python.
  - A dirty tree, as in local runs, or a missing key builds without caching.
  - A host without the `/sgl-data` mount gets a container-local cache, so it just misses every time, same as today.
- **Build method:** the build switches from `setup_rocm.py install` (an egg plus `easy-install.pth`) to `setup_rocm.py bdist_wheel` and `pip install --no-deps --force-reinstall`, so a cached build and a fresh one install the same way. Nothing else in the AMD scripts reads the egg or `kernels/aot/dist`.
- **Concurrency and cleanup:** jobs on one host can build the same key at once, so each builds into a temp dir and publishes with `mv -T`; the loser drops its copy. Entries not used for 7 days are pruned, and a hit refreshes the entry's mtime.
- **Bytecode:** clearing `__pycache__` in the checkout is kept.

## Test plan

- [x] `pr-test-amd.yml` dispatch on rocm10 ([run 40430315918](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40430315918)):
  - The install step took 128–133 s on a cache miss, against ~136 s before this change; that difference is the bytecode wipe. On a cache hit it took **97–99 s**. 4 of the 8 MI300 small shards hit; the 5 first-wave jobs started together, so each built its own copy.
  - `sgl-kernel-unit-test-amd` passes against the wheel install.
  - The gfx950 build works: `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x (0)` passes.
  - One small shard failed in `test_openai_server.py` (`cannot import name 'ResponseFunctionShellToolCall'`). That's the OpenAI SDK bump from #45291, fixed on main by #46774, not this change.

<!-- pr-states:start -->
---
### CI States

Latest PR Test (Extra): <!-- slot:pr-test-extra:start -->:x: [Run #40430396795](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40430396795)<!-- slot:pr-test-extra:end -->
Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): <!-- slot:pr-test-amd:start -->:x: [Run #40430396869](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40430396869)<!-- slot:pr-test-amd:end -->
<!-- pr-states:end -->

files.patch:
@@ -153,13 +153,47 @@ else
   docker exec ci_sglang pip uninstall sgl-kernel -y || true
   docker exec ci_sglang pip uninstall sglang-kernel -y || true
   docker exec ci_sglang pip uninstall sglang -y || true
-  # Clear Python cache to ensure latest code is used
-  docker exec ci_sglang find /opt/venv -name "*.pyc" -delete || true
-  docker exec ci_sglang find /opt/venv -name "__pycache__" -type d -exec rm -rf {} + || true
-  # Also clear cache in sglang-checkout
+  # Clear Python cache in the checkout so the latest code is used. The uninstalls
+  # above already removed the old sglang files from /opt/venv, so walking all of
+  # site-packages there (~6 s) only made every job recompile torch's bytecode.
   docker exec ci_sglang find /sglang-checkout -name "*.pyc" -delete || true
   docker exec ci_sglang find /sglang-checkout -name "__pycache__" -type d -exec rm -rf {} + || true
-  docker exec -w /sglang-checkout/python/sglang/kernels/aot ci_sglang bash -c "rm -f pyproject.toml && mv pyproject_rocm.toml pyproject.toml && python3 setup_rocm.py install"
+
+  # The AOT kernels depend only on python/sglang/kernels/aot, the image and the
+  # GPU arch, yet rebuilding them took ~30 s in every job. Cache the wheel on the
+  # persistent /sgl-data volume, keyed by the source tree hash and the image ID.
+  # A dirty tree (local runs) or a missing key always builds without caching.
+  AOT_KEY=""
+  if git diff --quiet HEAD -- python/sglang/kernels/aot 2>/dev/null; then
+    AOT_TREE=$(git rev-parse --short=16 HEAD:python/sglang/kernels/aot 2>/dev/null || true)
+    AOT_IMAGE=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' ci_sglang 2>/dev/null || true)
+    AOT_IMAGE="${AOT_IMAGE#sha256:}"
+    if [[ -n "${AOT_TREE}" && -n "${AOT_IMAGE}" ]]; then
+      AOT_KEY="${AOT_TREE}-${AOT_IMAGE:0:16}-${IMAGE_GFX}"
+    fi
+  fi
+  AOT_CACHE_ROOT=/sgl-data/sgl-kernel-wheels
+  AOT_CACHE="${AOT_CACHE_ROOT}/${AOT_KEY}"
+  if [[ -n "${AOT_KEY}" ]] && docker exec ci_sglang bash -c "ls ${AOT_CACHE}/*.whl" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    echo "[AOT] Reusing cached sglang-kernel wheel ${AOT_KEY}"
+    docker exec ci_sglang touch "${AOT_CACHE}" || true
+    AOT_WHEEL_DIR="${AOT_CACHE}"
+  else
+    echo "[AOT] Building sglang-kernel (cache key: ${AOT_KEY:-none})"
+    docker exec -w /sglang-checkout/python/sglang/kernels/aot ci_sglang bash -c "rm -f pyproject.toml && mv pyproject_rocm.toml pyproject.toml && rm -rf dist && python3 setup_rocm.py bdist_wheel"
+    AOT_WHEEL_DIR=/sglang-checkout/python/sglang/kernels/aot/dist
+    if [[ -n "${AOT_KEY}" ]]; then
+      # Publish atomically: concurrent jobs on the same host may build the same key.
+      docker exec ci_sglang bash -c "
+        mkdir -p ${AOT_CACHE_ROOT} &&
+        tmp=\$(mktemp -d ${AOT_CACHE_ROOT}/.tmp.XXXXXX) &&
+        cp ${AOT_WHEEL_DIR}/*.whl \"\$tmp\"/ &&
+        { mv -T \"\$tmp\" ${AOT_CACHE} 2>/dev/null || rm -rf \"\$tmp\"; }
+        find ${AOT_CACHE_ROOT} -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -mtime +7 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null
+      " || echo "[AOT] Warning: could not store the wheel in ${AOT_CACHE}" >&2
+    fi
+  fi
+  docker exec ci_sglang bash -c "pip install --no-deps --force-reinstall ${AOT_WHEEL_DIR}/*.whl"
 
   docker exec ci_sglang bash -c 'rm -rf python/pyproject.toml && mv python/pyproject_other.toml python/pyproject.toml'
   install_with_retry docker exec ci_sglang pip install --cache-dir=/sgl-data/pip-cache -e "python[${EXTRAS}]"
